description: This file defines API routes for managing orders in a food delivery backend. It includes endpoints for placing new orders, retrieving user orders, and fetching specific order details. It also contains internal functions for calculating total prices and simulating background order processing.

methods.name: calculate_total_price(item_ids)
methods.description: Calculates the total price of a list of item IDs based on their prices in the menu.

methods.name: fake_background_order_processing(order_id: int)
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous order processing by updating the order status over time.

methods.name: place_order( o: OrderCreate, BackgroundTasks: BackgroundTasks, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends() )
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new order, adds a background task to process it, and returns the order.

methods.name: get_my_orders(Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Retrieves all orders associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_order(order_id: int, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Fetches a specific order by its ID, with error handling if not found.

ctags.name: place_order
ctags.signature: ( o: OrderCreate, BackgroundTasks: BackgroundTasks, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends() )
